rationale: DESeq2 Wald on raw counts with ~condition, explicit control reference, apeglm shrinkage, and a stated n=3 power caveat fits the unpaired single-batch two-group design. QC is thorough (library sizes, size factors, VST PCA with variance explained, distance heatmap, dispersion plot) but the outlier policy stops at 'inspect' without stating what happens to a bad pool, and the low-count filter names the sample count but not the minimum count value. BH is only named in the enrichment step (padj is left implicit in Step 1), the |LFC|>1 count is a post hoc filter rather than lfcThreshold, and the GSEA ranking metric is left as a choice between two options. Enrichment correctly leads with native zebrafish GO and flags its thin coverage, uses the tested genes as universe, and gates any human-pathway tier on an ortholog map with reported mapping rate, but does not restrict to one-to-one orthologs, name the ortholog table version, or set a gene-set size window; the report also never names the Ensembl release.
